title: ReNDI+
description: A modified Fabric port of ReNDI for Minecraft 1.21.4+
body:
# ReNDI+

A modified Fabric port of **ReNDI** for **Minecraft 1.21.5-1.21.11**.

This mod removes most post-hit invulnerability frames, blocks very low-charge attacks, and suppresses knockback on low-charge hits. It is intended to improve combat flow in both PvE and PvP while preserving configurable exclusions for specific entities and damage sources.

## Features

- Removes most default post-hit invulnerability frames
- Cancels attacks below the configured charge threshold
- Cancels knockback below the configured knockback threshold
- Supports configurable exclusions for:
  - specific entities
  - specific received-damage entities
  - specific damage sources
- Includes Cloth Config integration
- Includes optional Mod Menu integration

## Requirements

- Minecraft `1.21.5 - 1.21.11`
- Fabric Loader `>= 0.17.3`
- Fabric API `>= 0.114.1+1.21.5`
- Cloth Config `>= 18.0.145`
- Mod Menu optional

## License

Source code for this modified version is available on GitHub.
